  • Method Details

    • decode

      @Deprecated public static void decode(ByteBuffer data, int length, StringBuilder target) throws org.apache.coyote.http2.HpackException
      Deprecated.
      Will be removed in Tomcat 12. Use decode(ByteBuffer, int, StringBuilder, boolean)
      Decodes a huffman encoded string into the target StringBuilder. There must be enough space left in the buffer for this method to succeed.
      Parameters:
      data - The byte buffer
      length - The length of data from the buffer to decode
      target - The target for the decompressed data
      Throws:
      org.apache.coyote.http2.HpackException - If the Huffman encoded value in HPACK headers did not end with EOS padding

    • decode

      public static void decode(ByteBuffer data, int length, StringBuilder target, boolean isFieldName) throws org.apache.coyote.http2.HpackException
      Decodes a huffman encoded string into the target StringBuilder. There must be enough space left in the buffer for this method to succeed.
      Parameters:
      data - The byte buffer
      length - The length of data from the buffer to decode
      target - The target for the decompressed data
      isFieldName - true if a field name is being decoded (names have a more restrictive set of allowed characters than field values)
      Throws:
      org.apache.coyote.http2.HpackException - If the Huffman encoded value in HPACK headers did not end with EOS padding

    • encode

      @Deprecated public static boolean encode(ByteBuffer buffer, String toEncode, boolean forceLowercase)
      Deprecated.
      Unused. This method will be removed in Tomcat 12 onwards.
      Encodes the given string into the buffer. If there is not enough space in the buffer, or the encoded version is bigger than the original it will return false and not modify the buffers position.
      Parameters:
      buffer - The buffer to encode into
      toEncode - The string to encode
      forceLowercase - If the string should be encoded in lower case
      Returns:
      true if encoding succeeded
